decisions.chain_element: discretize MNIST images with VQ-VAE into 49 discrete tokens

evidence.quote: Following data discretization in Section 3.2, we train a VQVAE (Van Den Oord et al., 2017) with six quantized vectors of dimension 32 and a compression ratio of 4.
This model converts the grayscale images of size 28 × 28 into 49 discrete tokens.

decisions.rationale: R3: VQ-VAE is a named learned module performing the discretization.
decisions.uncertainty: The paper describes VQ-VAE internals elsewhere, but this element retains the named module boundary.
